messages:
incident-bot: automated alert: PagerDuty triggered for service=\"inference-gateway\" region=prod-usw2 — HTTP 5xx rate spike above threshold (5m avg 6.8% > 3%). link: https://pagerduty.example/incident/INC-8921

pagerduty: page fired -> INC-8921. escalation policy: inference-prod. routing to maria (oncall).

maria (oncall): ack'd. I'm looking. any obvious recent deploys? :eyes:

raj (sre): no infra deploys in the last hour. seeing a sudden increase in upstream 502/504 from kvcache-proxy pods. CPU for gateway stays normal, but kvcache tail latency jumps. attaching quick snapshot: `curl -s https://metrics.example/api?m=inference.5xx|jq .`

lucy (frontend): support is seeing an increase in customer errors for completions API—tickets rolling in with examples showing 502s around 2026-03-17T09:21Z. Not all customers, looks like traffic routed to prod-usw2 only.

sam (support): pasted one ticket: "calls failing intermittently with 502, retrying sometimes works, impact: degraded feature for ~10% of requests". Customer affected: acme-inc (enterprise). CC: solutions-eng.

maria (oncall): thanks. runbook: inference-5xx -> step1: confirm scope, step2: fallback route, step3: scale/evict, step4: rollback if new model pinned. Doing scope now.

raj (sre): scope: errors concentrated on route `/v1/generate` behind envoy cluster inference-gateway-prod-usw2->kvcache-proxy. Sampled traces show kvcache 504 on cold misses causing cascade.

maria (oncall): diagnostics: `kubectl get pods -n prod | grep kvcache` shows a few restarts last 15m. `kubectl logs kvcache-proxy-7fd9 -n prod --tail 200` shows repeated `error: downstream: context deadline exceeded` and `eviction: out-of-memory?` Not fully sure.

raj (sre): quick mitigation options: 1) increase kvcache replicas (horizontal scale), 2) route small percentage of traffic to eu fallback, 3) enable in-memory cache warmup for hot prefixes. Which do we try first?

maria (oncall): scale first so we don't break sessions. running: `kubectl scale deployment kvcache-proxy -n prod --replicas=6` -> execing now.

ops-rotation: noted the scale request. if we hit noisy neighbor OOM, we'll need to check node memory.

maria (oncall): scale returned success. watching metrics...

raj (sre): metric update: 5xx rate down from 6.8% to 2.1% in the last 90s. latency for kvcache tail p95 improving. still seeing some residual 502s for long-tail keys.

lucy (frontend): support confirms fewer new tickets, but acme-inc still reports intermittent errors — they've throttled retries which made it worse for them.

maria (oncall): rolling a small traffic shift -> feature flag `usw2_fallback` to 5% to divert to eu fallback model. patching rollout: `redwoodctl routes update --cluster=prod-usw2 --route=/v1/generate --fallback=euw1 --weight=5%`

raj (sre): added temporary cache warmup job for top 500 prefixes: `jobs/warmup_kv_top500` kicked off. also enabled additional heap headroom on kvcache via configmap patch.

sam (support): I'm sending a note to acme-inc support thread: "we're mitigating an infrastructure 5xx spike, trying scaling + fallback. Will keep you updated every 15m."

maria (oncall): good. logging timeline in incident doc: https://confluence.example/incidents/INC-8921-diary

raj (sre): quick postmortem hypothesis: kvcache experienced partial OOM + eviction flurry after a change in cache eviction policy earlier today — caused cold miss amplification and proxy timeouts -> 5xx spike. Need to confirm config change history.

maria (oncall): I'm going to escalate to infra-engineering to review eviction policy. tagging @ops-rotation to take primary after I go for lunch in ~35m. Next steps: keep fallback at 5% until steady <1% 5xx, monitor customer tickets, open P1 if acme-inc sees sustained impact.

ops-rotation: ack handoff. I'll take primary at 1850010200 and continue monitoring. please leave runbook notes in confluence.

lucy (frontend): FYI can we surface a temporary status page note for impacted region? small note so customers know we're investigating.

maria (oncall): done: posted status update to status.redwood.example: "We are investigating increased 5xx errors for completions in US-West-2. Mitigations in progress."

raj (sre): logs show warmup job completed, cache hit ratio recovering to normal. 5xx now steady at 0.8% for 5m window.

sam (support): acme-inc acknowledges improvement after we shifted 5% traffic and scaled cache. They saw success rate jump immediately.

ops-rotation: will keep alert unmuted for next 60m and watch. leaving note: follow-up action items: (1) revert risky eviction policy change if confirmed, (2) add runbook step to auto-scale kvcache for sudden tail latency, (3) add synthetic checks hitting long-tail prefixes.

maria (oncall): thanks everyone. handing off to ops-rotation for watch. I'll mark resolved after handoff checkin if stable. :white_check_mark:

ops-rotation: checkin at 1850010800: 5xx baseline holds at 0.6%, no new customer complaints in last 30m. Closing active pager, will open a follow-up ticket for config review.

incident-bot: incident INC-8921 status -> resolved (mitigated, follow-up created: TASK-4032).
